content: Iconio yacno

Adashic, Pabadobëd icquido Iconio yacno choash tabadpanëdash. Ambo tabadec Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibante shubu yacno nidash puduedpanëdash. Ambo puduedshun Esuquidistu chuibanac isadaidbobëd isadaidpembo dadpen Esuquidistu tantiaquid yampanëdash.
Aido Esuquidistu tantiaquid yanubi isadaidbo utsibo Pabadon chuibanaid tantiatiapimbo icquin Esuquidistu tantiaquido muaquin chuiquin isadaidpembo utsibo nëishmepanëdash.

Aido nëishmiambi Iconio yacno yuec tabadquin Pabadon Bednabebëdtan dacuëdenquiocquin Esuquidistu chuibampanëdash. Aden chuibansho isun Nuquin Papan ambi nadatiambocquin tantiadempamboctequid ismequid Pabadobëdta Bednabe icmepanëdash.
Aden icmiac aid daëdshun nadatiambocquin nasho isash, Isadaidbo tsusiobon chuibocpadec Pabadobëd Bednabe icsambocquid nec, utsi-utsiec quenubien, Ambi chiaid abimbo iquec, utsibo quepanëdash.
Aden chuishumbic, Pabadobëdta Bednabe cuestanquin cuënoten se-senuequin Esus tantiesabo isadaidpembon aton tsusio dapabobëdtan cainubi adembidi isadaidbon aton tsusio dapabobëdtan cainoapanëdash.

Aden caimbededosh, quequin tantiaquidën chiac cuenec nidequi nidaid Dicaonia caid yacno Pabadobëd Bednabe choash shubu dadpen icquid Disteda caid yacno choash tabadquin Pabadobëdtan Bednaben Esuquidistu chuibampanëdash. Adtanec auëshquio puduanec nidec shubu dadpen icquid Dedbe caid yacnotsen choash tabadquin adomboembidi Esuquidistu chuibampanëdash. Adtanec auëshquio puduanec nidshun dëuequiec shubu dadpen icquid utsi-utsiec yacnocquidotsen chuibampanëdash.
Disteda yacno
Disteda yacno tabadnubien anocquid taicsaidi anin tishaid caputiapimbo icpanëdash.
Aidi Pabadon Esuquidistu chuibansho tantiec, Esuquidistun ëbi bëdamepatsiash, quec otacquio tsadpanëdash. Aden caputiapimbocquidën tantiacpadomboen Nuquin Papan Pabadotsen tantiamiac
caputiapimbocquid comapenen bëisquin: —Nidto —Pabadon cac badedi nidtoash taicsaid bëdanash capupanëdash.
Aden taicsaid bëdamiac capusho isash anocquido aton onqueten cuëdcuededquin: —Disteda yacnocquidon tantiaid matsesbimboec yanash abucuësh budoshe. Nëid daëdi isec cho —capanëdash.

Adtanequi Bednabe otacquio tsadquid icsho isash ambi tantiaid abentsëc Upited icnuc Upited cain Bednabe cuënquimbi Pabado chuiquidquio icsho isun ambi tantiaid utsi Medcudio icnuc Medcudio cain Pabado cuëmpanëdash Disteda yacnocquidon.

Aden cuënsho tantiashun baca bënë daëd bëec: Mibi daëdi tantiaquido Disteda yacnocquido nec, quequin, Ismenu, quequin ambibi tantiacbimboecnuc nacnenaid Upited caid dayun uaquido baca cuesunenu, quepanëdash.
Aden baca cuesunenuen bësho isun abi dasiuidaid aton dashcute bëntsecquid shoyonquin cancheuidashic iccuededquidon nënantanquio nidash Pabadobëd Bednabe comapenec nadpanëdash:

—Ëbi daëdi mibipadquid matsesquio nebi. Mimbi tantiacmaid nebique. Baca cuesunenda. Chiaid bëda mibitedi naden chuinuec chobi. Nuquin Papa caid abentsëcquiobi iquec. Aidëmbi abubëdta nidaid uashumbic aidënquiocquidtedi uabanampidquio neque. Aiduidtsëqui tantiaquin ambi uaidbimboecnuc matsesën nacnenaid tantiesa icta.
Ëndenquimbo Nuquin Papan, Adoenda, cainquiocnoc matsesën ambi tantiacpaden nabampampic.

Aden, Adoenda, cainquiocquimbi, Abitedishun icbo icquin bëdambocquid nebi, quequin ismequin ue secamedenequinc, cuëte bacuëmequinc, nuqui penun tiedën nitsimbeniaid canimequinc caquin Nuquin Papan nac bëdamboen nuquitedi pebededec. Aden nabanquin Nuquin Papan, Bëdambo iquebi. Cuishon, camiaido nuquitedi nec —quepanëdash Pabadobëd Bednabe Disteda yacnocquido chiec.
Aden chuido-chuidoaqui baca cuesunenquio icpanëdash Disteda yacnocquidon.

Adnubien Antioquiya caid yacnocquidobëd Iconio yacnocquido Disteda yacno cho-choshon, Pabado icsambocquid nec, quequin chiac Disteda caid yacnocquido nëishcuededpanëdash. Adec nëishcuededshun Pabado cuënoten se-siash, Unësosh, queshun nimbanquin buanshun shubu nibëdacno Pabado netampanëdash.

Ambo netanambic, Esuquidistu tantiaquido cho-choshon tsicatenubi Pabado nidtoash Esuquidistu tantiaquidobëd Disteda yacno choec shubun puduedpanëdash. Badiadash puduanec shubu dadpen icquid Dedbe caid yacno Pabadobëd Bednabe nidoapanëdash.
Nidaid Sidia caid shubu dadpen icquid Antioquiya yacno choaid

Adec Dedbe yacno choash tabadquimbi Pabadobëdtan Bednaben chuibanac Esuquidistu tantiaquid dadpen yampanëdash. Auëshquio puduanec nidoaic padpidec Disteda caid yacno choash tabadquin, Dadpen tantiamequiono, quequin chuibampanëdash.

Aden chuibanshumbic: —Natiamianquid iquendac. Adquid icnuc Nuquin Papa yacno puduedash Esuquidistu tantiaquid yec ambo nuquitedi tabadendac, quec nëbi dayacquio yec tabad —capanëdash Pabadon. Adotanquin ambia Esus tantiaquid utsi-utsien Pabadobëdtan Bednaben: —Bëdamboec tabadquin ismequin Esuquidistu tantiaquid utsibo chuiban —capanëdash. Adotanec, ambi chuiboedobëd Pabado Bednabe chedo Nuquin Papauidi tantiec buna mëmunquin chiec onquepanëdash. Aden Nuquin Papa chuiquin naimbudquin, Nëmbocquid mibi tantiaquido bëdamboen dayun uata, Papa, quequin chianec Pabadobëd Bednabe chedo Disteda yacnoësh nidoapanëdash. Adecbidi Iconio yacno choashun adomboembidi chuibanoapanëdash. Adecbidi Antioquiya yacno choashun adomboembidi chuibanoapanëdash. Antioquiya yacnoësh puduanec nidec nidaid Pisidia caid datambëtsenec nidaid Pampidia caid yacno choash nidec
shubu dadpen icquid Pedque caid yacno choash tabadquin Esuquidistu chuibanash shubu dadpen icquid Atadia caid yacnotsen chopanëdash.
Auëshquio cano antabëdtoanec nidec shubu dadpen icquid Antioquiya caid yacno, Nuquin Papan Mayanën nidta, quequin chiondacnombo choapanëdash.

Ambo choash tabadquin anocquido Esuquidistu tantiaquid utsibobëd iccuededshun Nuquin Papan tantiamiacpaden abi capucueniacnoshon ambi nabanaidtedi Pabadobëdtan Bednaben chuibampanëdash. Isadaidpembo dadpen Esuquidistu tantiaquid yamposh, quequin chuipanëdash.
Adtanequi yuec Antioquiya yacno Esuquidistu tantiaquid utsibobëdi Pabado Bednabe chedo tabadpanëdash.
